python3 - <<'PY'
import os
import platform
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
print('当前目录:', root)
print('系统信息:', platform.platform())
print('终端尺寸:', os.environ.get('COLUMNS'), os.environ.get('LINES'))
print('当前目录内容:')

for path in sorted(root.iterdir(), key=lambda item: item.name)[:30]:
    try:
        info = path.stat()
        kind = '目录' if path.is_dir() else '文件'
        print(f'{kind}\t{info.st_size:>12}\t{path.name}')
    except OSError as error:
        print(f'无法读取\t{path.name}\t{error}')

print('目录检查完成')
PY
